issues.title: Store notes locally so they can be edited offline
issues.body:
Persist notes in a local store that works without a connection. Existing search must keep working.

Acceptance:
- create and edit with no network
- search returns offline notes

Out of scope: syncing.

issues.title: Sync local notes when the device is back online
issues.body:
Push and pull changes when a connection is available. Retry with backoff.

Acceptance:
- a note created offline appears on the server after reconnect
- no duplicate notes after a retry

issues.title: Resolve conflicts between two edits of the same note
issues.body:
Last write wins per field. The losing value is kept in the note's history.

Acceptance:
- two edits to different fields both survive
- two edits to the same field keep the newer value and the older one in history

issues.title: Show sync status in the toolbar
issues.body:
Show synced, syncing, offline or conflict. Announce changes to VoiceOver users.

Acceptance:
- the status matches the sync engine state
- the label is available to assistive technology
